claims.statement: For an m x 2 orthonormal frame S with every row leverage at most 1/2, invertible symmetric Gamma, independent coordinate densities at most 1, and arbitrary one-coordinate measurable potentials, the resulting rank-two quadratic-plus-coordinatewise-potential law has an L3 density with norm at most (3e)^(2/3)|det Gamma|^(-1/3).

For a rank-three spectral form, after a nonzero physical spectral-Schur pivot a with row leverage c, if the rank-two residual frame is diffuse (row leverages at most 1/2), then the quadratic-form density is essentially bounded by 4 sqrt(3e)(|a| c |det Lambda|)^(-1/4).

Convert second-level residual localization or a near-isotropic localized pivot into a dimension-free paid Schur, pure-cross, cross-block, or diffuse mechanism under only the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis.
